name: Dwarven District
summary: Tucked into the northern corner of Stormwind City, the Dwarven District is a bustling industrial enclave filled with roaring furnaces, ringing anvils, and thick smog. Home to many of the city's dwarven craftsmen, it serves as the beating mechanical heart of the city.

sections.title: A Home Away from Khaz Modan
sections.body: The northern quarter of Stormwind is home to the city's dwarven artisans, smiths, and engineers and their trades. The district retains the unmistakable character of Ironforge, dominated by heavy stone masonry, sprawling smelting operations, and bustling craft shops. Shops such as Potts' Plates provide a familiar haven for craftspeople from Khaz Modan. It also houses the Stormwind portal to the Deeprun Tram, tethering the human capital directly to Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is there a dwarven enclave in Stormwind?
aliases: why is it called dwarven district
faq.answer: How the enclave was founded is not recorded in the chronicles of this era. Today it is home to dwarven smiths, miners, and engineers whose forges and workshops give the quarter its character, and the Deeprun Tram links it directly to Ironforge.

faq.q: How do you get to Ironforge from here?
faq.answer: On the eastern side of the district, an open arched tunnel leads directly into the Deeprun Tram station. This subterranean marvel connects Stormwind to Ironforge within minutes.

faq.q: What professions are trained in the Dwarven District?
faq.answer: Given its industrial character, the district is the city's premier hub for mining, blacksmithing, and engineering. It features heavy forges, anvils, and dedicated trainers for these craft disciplines.

faq.q: Where can hunters train in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind's hunters make their headquarters in the Dwarven District's Hunter's Guild, fittingly sharing quarters and trade supplies alongside dwarven marksmen.

angles.text: For dwarves far from Khaz Modan, this district offers a familiar comfort: the roar of working blast furnaces, and quick passage back to Ironforge.
The district provides Stormwind's most capable smithing facilities, equipped with expansive smelting forges, sturdy anvils, and veteran instructors.
